extends Node
class_name SceneLoader

signal progress_updated(fraction)
signal load_completed(scene)
signal load_failed(reason)

var _state: int = 0  # 0=idle, 1=loading, 2=loaded, 3=failed
var _current_loader = null  # ResourceLoader.Loader in background mode (not all builds expose)
var _polling_timer: Timer = null
var _thread: Thread = null
var _thread_path: String = ""
var _thread_progress: float = 0.0
var _thread_result: Resource = null
var _thread_error: String = ""
var _thread_mutex: Mutex = Mutex.new()
var _load_steps: int = 0

func start_load(path: String) -> bool:
	if _state == 1:
		return false
	# Use ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request which works in standard Godot.
	_thread_path = path
	_thread_progress = 0.0
	_thread_result = null
	_thread_error = ""
	var err: int = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
	if err != OK:
		_state = 3
		_thread_error = "ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request failed: %d" % err
		load_failed.emit(_thread_error)
		_state = 0
		return true
	_state = 1
	_load_steps = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_load_steps(path)
	if _polling_timer == null:
		_polling_timer = Timer.new()
		_polling_timer.wait_time = 0.05
		_polling_timer.one_shot = false
		add_child(_polling_timer)
		_polling_timer.timeout.connect(_poll)
		_polling_timer.start()
	else:
		_polling_timer.start()
	return true

func _poll() -> void:
	if _state != 1:
		return
	var err_progress = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(_thread_path, _thread_progress)
	# _thread_progress here is actually an array in some signatures; ensure we handle both.
	# In Godot 4, the signature is: load_threaded_get_status(path, progress_array)
	# progress_array is a 1-element Array. We pass it by ref via a temp var.
	_progress_emit(err_progress)
	if err_progress == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
		_polling_timer.stop()
		var res: Resource = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(_thread_path)
		_state = 2
		load_completed.emit(res)
	elif err_progress == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_FAILED or err_progress == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
		_polling_timer.stop()
		_state = 3
		_thread_error = "Thread load failed with status: %d" % err_progress
		load_failed.emit(_thread_error)
		_state = 0

func _progress_emit(status: int) -> void:
	# _thread_progress holds an Array with one float; clamp and emit.
	var fraction: float = 0.0
	if _thread_progress is Array:
		fraction = float(_thread_progress[0])
	else:
		fraction = float(_thread_progress)
	fraction = clamp(fraction, 0.0, 1.0)
	progress_updated.emit(fraction)

func cancel() -> void:
	if _state == 1:
		if _polling_timer != null:
			_polling_timer.stop()
		_state = 0
		_thread_path = ""
		_thread_progress = 0.0

func is_loading() -> bool:
	return _state == 1
GDEOF
